Same asset linked twice results in one download with one unique hash

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import scrape, create_engine, CrawlConfig

async def main() -> None:
    engine_config = CrawlConfig(download_assets=True)
    engine = create_engine(engine_config)
    url = "https://example.com"
    result = await scrape(engine, url)
    print(result.status_code)
    print(len(result.assets))
    print(result.assets[0].content_hash)

asyncio.run(main())
```
